hypothesis: Coordinate-error minimization can select a worse calibration than physical interval consensus even without neural optimization or input-dependent transfer complexity.
exposure: Same 50k rows as local-function. Base/calibration historical exposure retained. No species-distance metric is used. No U/D labels fit constants.
changed_factor: Constant fitting criterion only: coordinate Smooth L1 versus maximum acceptable-interval interior coverage with zero tie preference
smooth_l1: 64 monotone-derivative bisection steps, beta=log(1.1), min/max target bracket, no regularizer; choose nearest-zero minimizer when flat
interval: GPU stable endpoint sort per species; midpoint of each nonempty gap; maximize coverage; tie by smallest absolute midpoint; prefer zero if its physical training count is at least as high; record numerical fallback
qualification: Interior consensus omits isolated endpoint-only maxima; no claim of exact discrete maximum. Physical recount, not interval counts, defines success.
work_policy: Finite deterministic algorithms: 64 bisections or one endpoint sort plus two physical recounts. Equal parameter count, not equal FLOPs or optimizer updates.
checkpoint: One final deterministic fit; no checkpoint or development selection
inference: states -> frozen GBCT -> fixed per-species asinh coordinate shift -> signed increment. No query reference or temperature routing.
scoring: Unchanged campaign and evaluator lock, against fixed anchor and incumbent; no automatic promotion
timing: Same 1023-state alternating candidate/base end-to-end timing protocol

outcomes.interval_transfers: Objective alignment has a transferable intercept signal; apply every guard and investigate remaining failures
outcomes.train_only: Global intercept calibration does not transfer; do not add another constant loss
outcomes.negligible_training_gain: Close global-shift explanation; use conditional structure or alternative target modeling
outcomes.accuracy_but_validity_failure: Keep rejected status; a separately declared physical constraint may be tested without weakening gates
